_comment: Row 283 real-process claim transaction battery. M1 removes the OS-backed exclusion that keeps a reader away from a truncated in-flight record. M2 restores last-writer-wins same-owner publication after serialized adders. Re-run from a detached scratch copy with toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row283_bd_claim_transactions.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH. The separate transform-control spec applies the identical M1 transform to an import-only test and must ESCAPE.
subject: bd-claim readers cannot erase an in-flight claim and concurrent same-owner adders preserve both path sets
